page.layout: One printed page, text in one column with brace diagrams and references inline; running head at top right; page number at top left; catchword-like word "Multarum" at foot right.

main_text.head: Lib. 8.
main_text.p: Specialis confe cratio duo habet membra { Vestimentorum impositio specialis. Vnctio specialis. } Exod. 29.5.6. 7.8.9.
Prima erat quae ex speciali vestium differentia orta est. ibid.
Vestes illae sunt quae in propriam gloriam, & ornatum summi sacerdotis factae sunt. Exod.28.2.
Causas autem habuerunt cum Tabernaculo communes. Exod.28.3.4.5.6.7.
Praestantes sunt, quae ob materiam & visum, inferiores praestantioribus erant. Exodus. 28. 7. 38.39.
Praestantiores, quae materia, forma & visu praecellebant. Exod.28.6.39.
main_text.l: Sunt autem { Reliquarum partium. Capitis. } Exo.28.4 6.15.31.36.
main_text.p: Reliquarum partium vestes etiam sunt { Multarum. Pectorale sacrum. Exod.28.4.

page.notes: Printed brace diagrams were rendered as lines of text; the small running head and the "Multarum" catchword at the foot are as printed. Some words in the braces are rendered from partial reading and are uncertain, e.g. "Texsellata" and "visum".
